citations.quote: CFA Institute program rules, regulations, and policies prohibit candidates from disclosing confidential material gained during the exam process.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard VII.A PROHIBITS conduct that compromises the reputation/integrity of CFA Institute, the CFA designation, or program integrity (exam secrecy, candidate conduct, public-representation conduct). VII.B REQUIRES accurate reference to CFA Institute, the designation, candidacy, and the CFA marks per published guidelines; misrepresentation of meaning or implications violates the Standard.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard VII Responsibilities as a CFA Institute Member or CFA Candidate
